summary: No more guessing stars — just point your phone and find out!
description: Star Walk 2 Plus: Sky Map View is your personal window to the universe. Point your device at the night sky and uncover the beauty of the cosmos in real time. This award-winning stargazing app helps you explore stars, constellations, planets, satellites, comets, and other celestial wonders wherever you are. ★ Discover the sky around you Turn your phone into a precise star map and identify every light above the horizon. Watch the motion of stars and planets as you move your device, or travel through time to see past and future skies. It’s your ultimate sky guide and planet finder — effortless, beautiful, and always at hand. ★ New features to enjoy • Planet Walk – see all planets at once, track alignments, and explore their orbits. • Quizzes – test your astronomy knowledge and challenge your friends. • Infographics – grasp complex celestial events through elegant visuals. • Interactive stories – learn the myths and science behind every constellation. • Sky Live and Visible Tonight – find the best moments to observe planets and constellations. • Refreshed design, faster navigation, and a more intuitive interface for smooth exploration. ★ Observe with precision • Real-time AR view merges the map with the real night sky star finder. • Accurate data for stars, constellations, planets, comets, and satellites overhead. • Night-mode interface ensures comfortable dark-sky sessions. • Adjustable time scale lets you follow the celestial dance through centuries. ★ Trusted worldwide Used by tour guides on Easter Island and astronomy programs in the Maldives, Star Walk 2 Plus bridges science and wonder, connecting people with the universe above them. ★ Why choose this stargazing app • Works offline – perfect for remote adventures. • Suits both beginners and experienced observers. • Inspiring visuals and accurate astronomical data. • Comparable in depth to Stellarium Mobile, yet simpler to navigate. ★ Your journey starts now Look up and let the universe unfold. Download Star Walk 2 Plus: Sky Map View – a timeless star guide that transforms every night into a cosmic experience.
